page.overview:
Who is Julius?

Julius is a temporary party member and the main antagonist of Final Fantasy Adventure.

His father was the emperor of the Vandole Empire, which was on the verge of world domination before being defeated by the Gemma Knights and Fuji's Mother. When the empire's side was losing , Julius' father left his baby son, the empire's last hope, inside the cave of the waterfalls. Sometime later, Julius was found by Dark Lord, ruler of the Glaive Empire, who took him in and raised him as his own.

Many years later, Dark Lord began his own quest for world domination, with Julius as his right-hand man. Dark Lord sends Julius on a mission to retrieve a Pendant of Mana and the girl that owns it. With both in their possession, they could reverse the flow of the waterfall that leads to the top of Mount Illusia, where no airship can reach. At the top of the mountain lies the Tree of Mana, and anyone who touches it will gain its ultimate power. However, neither Julius nor Dark Lord know the consequences of this action.

After finding the girl ( named Fuji ) , wearing the pendant, he disguises himself and pretends to befriend her guardian, Sumo, in the Cave of Marsh and together they defeat the Hydra and recover the Mirror. He is then seen in Wendel, and overhearing the discussion with Cibba, obtains confirmation that the girl is indeed the one Dark Lord was looking for. Saying that the Glaive Empire is attacking the city, he pretends to take the girl to safety, but then unveiled his true identity. He was in the process of escorting her back to Glaive Castle on his airship when Sumo interfered in an attempt to rescue her. Julius knocked him off the airship with a spell, but not before Sumo got a hold of the pendant.
